answer: Time is the one toll no farm can fake. Each tide a fresh beacon ripples out, and every ballot must anchor its key to it by solving a verifiable delay function: a chain of T squarings no parallel machine can shortcut. One VDF takes 10 minutes of single-threaded work, verifies in seconds, and each ballot stakes $50 until its proof lands. A farm pushing 10,000 ballots through one rig stalls at the delay check: 36 ballots per 6-hour tide, so 10,000 need 278 machines and $500,000 staked. Late proofs are rejected, stakes slashed; like yarrow, honest ballots grow one slow root and hold.
